prompt: Before 2024, among her own record-breaking streaks, in which Olympic event has Katie Ledecky broken the world record the second most times?
answer: Katie Ledecky broke the world record the **second-most times in the women’s 800-meter freestyle**. Her most frequent record-breaking event was the **1,500-meter freestyle**.
